```{=html}
<div class="sea" aria-hidden="true">
  <video autoplay muted loop playsinline disablepictureinpicture disableremoteplayback
         poster="/assets/landing/sea-poster.webp">
    <source src="/assets/landing/sea.mp4" type="video/mp4">
  </video>
</div>
<script>
  // Under prefers-reduced-motion the sea holds still on its first frame, which
  // is the poster. This runs before the clip starts loading, so dropping
  // autoplay and preload here keeps it from downloading at all.
  (() => {
    const video = document.querySelector(".sea video");
    const still = matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
    if (still.matches) {
      video.autoplay = false;
      video.preload = "none";
    }
    still.addEventListener("change", () => {
      if (!still.matches) return video.play().catch(() => {});
      video.pause();
      video.currentTime = 0;
    });
  })();
</script>
```
